purpose: Adversarial CRM language holdout (mandate §48). Tests the semantics the mandate specifies in §13-§19: company possession vs candidate experience vs alternatives lists vs customer integration, and current vs recent vs historical.
groundTruthBasis: Each expected level follows directly from the mandate's own stated rules, not from my judgement about any company. §17 makes possession decisive and experience supporting; §18 makes alternatives lists MENTION_ONLY; §19 makes customer integration non-evidence; §13-15 set current/recent/historical by date; §45 forbids snippets and fingerprints from confirming.
discipline: Frozen before the classifier was wired to the forensics layer. Not edited after seeing results. Cases are written as sentences rather than company names so the ground truth cannot drift with the web.
